id: -701-辛那赫里布在黎凡特的行動

battle.name: 辛那赫里布在黎凡特的行動
battle.brief: 公元前701年秋，亞述王辛那赫里布第三次西征，沿腓尼基海岸強收西頓、推羅與非利士諸王貢賦，轉兵南下，圍困猶大王希西家的設防城邑，最終以攻城槌攻下拉基什，並在厄爾提卡擊潰前來解圍的埃及與Kush聯軍。卡面月牙劍屬埃及一方，隨法老軍作戰，卻敗在亞述弓手與鐵製攻城器之下。

kit.name: 埃及月牙劍
kit.history: 外彎的單刃劍，砍下去不用拔。它比直劍更早出現在埃及人的手上。

countries: 這場行動由新亞述帝國發動，形式上是一次王軍巡行，實際是一次以武力為後盾的整個黎凡特主權接管。亞述一方是高度集中的王權直屬軍：步兵以亞述弓手為主幹，前列是手持長矛、披掛鐵片或青銅鱗甲的列陣步兵，後方有擲石手與攻城部隊，兩翼有騎兵與戰車兵；全軍由國王辛那赫里布一人統率，連徵召、賞罰與戰後分配俘虜都由他決定，公元前705年把都城由亞述城遷到尼尼微之後，這支軍隊的指揮與補給樞紐也一併搬到了尼尼微。反方並非單一國家，而是一個散亂的反叛聯盟：猶大王希西家是名義上的核心，北面的以革倫、基頓、阿斯克倫等非利士城邦各自結盟自保，腓尼基沿岸的西頓與推羅起初仍以稱臣納貢應對，北方與東方還有阿拉美與亞捫各部族趁亂脫離控制。真正構成正面的對抗的是埃及與Kush（努比亞）聯軍：法老塔哈卡把他的兒子西艾塞派到前線指揮，埃及步兵與Kush弓箭手越過西奈半島北上，試圖在沿海低地把亞述軍擋住。除此之外，腓尼基各城還能提供海船與商隊，亞述則是一支以陸軍為主、輔以被征服地區舟師的帝國軍隊，攻守的節奏完全由亞述一方設定。
countriesEn: This operation was launched by the Neo-Assyrian Empire. On the surface it was a royal progress; in practice it was an armed takeover of sovereignty across the whole Levant. The Assyrian side was a highly centralised army belonging directly to the king: the infantry core was the Assyrian archers, with ranked spearmen in front wearing iron or bronze scale armour, slingers and siege specialists behind them, and cavalry and chariotry on the wings. The entire host was commanded by King Sennacherib in person; levies, rewards, punishments and the disposal of captives after the fighting were all his decisions, and when he moved the capital from Ashur to Nineveh in 705 BC the command and supply hub of this army moved to Nineveh with it. The opposing side was not a single state but a loose rebel alliance. Judah under King Hezekiah was its nominal centre; northern Philistine cities such as Ekron, Gath and Ashkelon banded together for self-defence; the Phoenician cities of Sidon and Tyre at first met the demand with submission and tribute; and in the north and east, the Aramee and Ammonite tribes slipped out of Assyrian control while the war was being fought. The real opposing force was the Egyptian and Kushite (Nubian) coalition: Pharaoh Taharqa put his son Si-Ese in command of it, and Egyptian infantry and Kushite archers crossed Sinai northward to try to hold the Assyrian army in the coastal lowlands. On top of that, the Phoenician cities could supply ships and merchant caravans, whereas Assyria was an empire whose army was primarily land-based, with fleets drawn from the subjugated regions as an auxiliary. The tempo of attack and defence was set entirely by the Assyrian side.
people: 辛那赫里布（阿卡德語Sîn-akheri-bi，意思近於「銅的擁有者只有主神」）是這次行動的中心。公元前705年父王薩爾貢二世在宮中被刺，他以長子身份在尼尼微即位，即位後最先做的大事之一就是把都城由亞述城遷往尼尼微，並在城中興建西南宮等巨大宮殿；他在位二十四年，是第一位把亞述的戰爭寫進大量自傳式銘文的君王，拉基什的浮雕就出自他宮中的工匠之手。猶大王希西家是另一端的關鍵人物：他在公元前701年拒絕繼續進貢，動員全境修築城牆與地下水道，把耶路撒冷守成一座要塞，最後以巨額金銀換取亞述退兵。埃及方面帶兵北上的是法老塔哈卡之子西艾塞，巴比倫編年史記載他率埃及與Kush的聯軍在厄爾提卡敗退；法老塔哈卡本人坐鎮埃及，把援軍與金錢送到前線。亞述軍內被刻上名字的有守城方的「拉基什城總督提革拉·帕拉萨」與王宮近衛首長「拉布沙克西」，國王本人則以端坐王座、接受希西家進貢的姿態，出現在長達十二幅的連續浮雕之中。
peopleEn: Sennacherib (Akkadian Sîn-akheri-bi, roughly 'only the lord has the bronze') was the centre of this operation. In 705 BC his father Sargon II was assassinated in the palace; Sennacherib took the throne as firstborn at Nineveh, and one of his first acts was to move the capital from Ashur to Nineveh and begin building enormous palaces there, the Southwest Palace among them. He ruled for twenty-four years and was the first Assyrian king to set down long, self-congratulatory accounts of his own wars in inscription, and the Lachish reliefs were the work of the craftsmen in his own palace. On the other end stood Hezekiah, king of Judah, the other key figure: in 701 BC he refused to keep paying tribute, mobilised the whole country to raise walls and underground conduits, held Jerusalem as a fortress, and finally bought off the Assyrians with an enormous payment in gold and silver. On the Egyptian side the army that marched north was commanded by Si-Ese, son of Pharaoh Taharqa; the Babylonian Chronicle records that his Egyptian and Kushite coalition was broken at Eltekeh, while Taharqa himself stayed in Egypt and sent men and money forward. Named in the Assyrian camp are the defenders' commander, 'Tiglat-Pileser, governor of the city of Lachish', and 'Rab-shakesh', chief of the royal bodyguard, while the king himself appears seated on his throne receiving the tribute of Hezekiah in the middle of a continuous series of twelve relief panels.
kits: 卡面這把埃及月牙劍是青銅單刃、外彎的短刀形劍，握柄與劍身一體鑄成，砍下去不必拔刀；它在古埃及從第十二王朝一路流行到新王國，但到公元前701年已經退居象徵層面，不作實戰兵器，只作為法老與軍官的徽記、配飾與禮器。也就是說，它在厄爾提卡戰場上真正可能出現的方式，多半是掛在埃及貴族或軍官身上，而不是由普通士卒拿來揮砍；埃及與Kush聯軍真正決定戰果的武器是裝在皮護具裡的青銅鏃箭、短矛與斧，以及木、骨、角製的複合弓與名為「泰胡提」的弓。亞述方面的裝備則是另一套系統：亞述弓手用角木複合弓與箭袋，箭矢有銅鏃也有鐵鏃；重步兵披鐵片或青銅鱗甲，配直刃短劍與長柄矛；國王與貴族戴尖頂盔、披帶鱗甲的長袍，盾牌分圓形與橢圓形；戰車單馬牽引，車輪包釘，車上有持圓盾的車夫與射手。攻城裝備才是拉基什戰役的關鍵：可拆卸的攻城塔用牛車分件運送，攻城槌以包鐵的橫梁撞擊城牆與城門，另有投石機、鐵鏟與攻城用的繩梯，輔以大量擲石手。整個後勤由牛拉的貨車、駱駝與騾子承擔，沿海城鎮的糧食與木材是這支部隊西進的主要補給來源。
kitsEn: The Egyptian khopesh on the card is a single-edged bronze sword with an outward curve, cast in one piece with its handle, so that it does not have to be pulled back out of a target after a blow. It was carried in Egypt from the Twelfth Dynasty through the New Kingdom, but by 701 BC it had withdrawn into the symbolic: no longer a weapon of war, but an insignia, an ornament and a ritual object of pharaohs and officers. In other words, the only way the khopesh could really appear on the field of Eltekeh was hanging on an Egyptian nobleman or officer rather than swung by an ordinary soldier. What decided the fate of the Egyptian and Kushite coalition was the quiver of bronze-tipped arrows, the short spear and the axe, together with composite bows of wood, bone and horn and the bow known as the Tjehuty. The Assyrian equipment belonged to a different system altogether. Assyrian archers used horn-and-wood composite bows and quivers, with arrows carrying both bronze and iron heads; heavy infantry wore iron or bronze scale armour and carried straight-edged short swords and long spears; the king and his nobles wore conical helmets and long fringed scale-armoured robes, and shields came in round and oval forms. The chariots were single-horse, with iron-shod wheels, carrying a round-shielded driver and an archer. Siege equipment was the key of the battle of Lachish: dismantlable siege towers were moved in pieces on ox-carts, battering rams with metal-shod beams struck at walls and gates, and there were also stone-throwers, iron picks and scaling ladders, supported by a large body of slingers. The whole of the logistics rested on ox-drawn wagons, camels and mules, and the grain and timber of the coastal towns were the main supply of this army on its march west.
tactics: 亞述的戰法在這次行動中沒有例外：遠射先行，密集的箭雨越過舉盾的步兵壓向城頭，然後重裝方陣持矛逼近，城門與城牆以攻城槌對付，缺口一旦打開即以突擊步兵湧入；騎兵與戰車在兩翼收拾潰退的敵軍，擲石手則用來壓制城頭。拉基什的連續浮雕把這套程序完整記錄下來：亞述軍先在城外紮營，再把攻城塔推向城下，槌手在塔上與地面操縱攻城槌，弓手登上塔樓射擊城頭守軍，隨後士兵攀上城牆，奪門、縱火，最後是成隊的居民被押出城門。厄爾提卡的戰鬥則是先發制人：巴比倫編年史記載，埃及與Kush聯軍在夜間丟下裝備與衣物退走，亞述軍趁勢攻入營地，奪得埃及與Kush軍的兵器與帳幕。對耶路撒冷則不同，亞述軍沒有強攻城牆，只用長期圍困與切斷外圍來逼降，最後在沒有攻破城池的情況下接受希西家送來的巨額貢品後撤軍。
tacticsEn: Assyrian method did not deviate in this operation. Missiles came first: dense volleys of arrows passed over the shield-bearing infantry and swept the ramparts; the armoured formation then advanced with spears; walls and gates were dealt with by battering ram; and once a breach opened, assault infantry poured through. Cavalry and chariots on the wings harvested the broken enemy, while slingers were used to silence the defenders on the wall. The continuous Lachish relief records this whole procedure: the Assyrian army first encamped outside the city, then pushed the siege towers forward, ram crews working the beams from the towers and from the ground, archers climbing the towers to shoot at the wall, then soldiers scaling the walls, taking the gate and setting fires, and finally rows of inhabitants marched out under guard. Eltekeh was decided by initiative: the Babylonian Chronicle records that the Egyptian and Kushite coalition withdrew at night, abandoning its equipment and clothing, and the Assyrians stormed the camp and took the arms, gear and pavilions of the Egyptian and Kushite troops. Jerusalem was different: the Assyrians did not try to storm the walls, but applied a long blockade and the cutting of the approaches to force surrender, and finally withdrew after accepting the enormous tribute Hezekiah sent, without the city ever being breached.
data: 關於兵力與數字，亞述方面的可靠記錄主要來自王室的第三代戰役記錄與尼尼微的浮雕。可以確定的數字有：希西家被圍困於「四十六座設防城市」；王室記錄中最常被引用的擄走人口數為猶大等地合計200,700人，另有一組數字指拉基什一城被擄走46,000人；希西家送出的貢品以數百塔連特計（一塔連特約三十公斤上下），不同抄本分別作數百塔連特黃金與數百塔連特白銀，並附寶石與織物。埃及與Kush聯軍的兵力數字沒有留下來，巴比倫編年史只記錄了他們的敗走與被繳獲的裝備，現代學者多估計援軍為數萬之譜。拉基什浮雕由十二塊石板組成，每塊寬約四點五米，畫面上人數稠密，學者據此推想攻城軍為數萬人；圍城的確切月數則無從考證，浮雕與銘文都沒有記載。人口方面，聖經所記希西家時代猶大與其餘北方支派合計四十五萬，是常被引用的上限，現代考古學者多認為偏高；耶路撒冷在前701年的人口則常被估在一萬五千至兩萬五千之間。辛那赫里布在位時間為公元前705年至前681年，共二十四年。
dataEn: For numbers, the reliable Assyrian evidence comes mainly from the royal account of the third campaign and from the reliefs at Nineveh. The figures that can be stated are these: Hezekiah was shut up in 'forty-six strong cities'; the number of people deported most often quoted from the royal record is 200,700 for Judah and the other districts, with another set of figures giving 46,000 deported from the city of Lachish alone; the tribute sent by Hezekiah is counted in hundreds of talents, a talent being roughly thirty kilograms, with different copies giving several hundreds of talents of gold and several hundreds of talents of silver, together with precious stones and textiles. No figure survives for the size of the Egyptian and Kushite army: the Babylonian Chronicle records only their flight and the equipment taken from them, and modern scholars generally estimate the relief force at tens of thousands. The Lachish relief is made up of twelve slabs, each about four and a half metres wide, and the scene is densely populated, which leads scholars to imagine a besieging army in the tens of thousands; the exact length of the siege cannot be established, because neither the relief nor the inscriptions record it. On population, the biblical figure of four hundred and fifty thousand for Judah and the northern tribes in the time of Hezekiah is a commonly quoted upper limit which modern archaeologists generally consider too high; the population of Jerusalem in 701 BC is usually estimated at between fifteen and twenty-five thousand. Sennacherib reigned from 705 to 681 BC, a total of twenty-four years.
cause: 直接起因是亞述西部的宗主體系在同一個時段全面崩解。前一年（公元前703年），巴比倫王馬爾杜克·阿普拉·阿迪納一世舉兵奪位，辛那赫里布第一次西征便把他打回原位並把王位帶回尼尼微，此後亞述對黎凡特各城的約束鬆了一陣；就在這個窗口裡，希西家停止進貢、與亞述斷絕關係，非利士諸城也各自結盟，埃及的Kush王朝則在第二十五王朝的框架下把手伸過西奈，把軍隊與金錢源源不斷送入巴勒斯坦。巴比倫編年史記載塔哈卡曾經北上進入猶大，與被困的希西家一同死守城門，這說明埃及不是旁觀者，而是這場反叛的後盾。更深一層的原因是結構性的：亞述帝國的運作依靠貢賦而不是直接佔領，每一個不肯照例進貢的附庸國都被視為帝國秩序的破口；辛那赫里布登位後需要一次成功的西征來重新確認帝國在黎凡特的邊界，同時切斷埃及與Kush的聯繫，並把沿地中海的商路與黎巴嫩木材線置於有效控制之下。
causeEn: The immediate cause was the wholesale breakdown of the Assyrian overlordship system in the west during the same period. The year before, in 703 BC, the Babylonian king Marduk-apla-iddina I rebelled and seized the throne; Sennacherib's first western campaign put him back in his place and carried the royal dignity off to Nineveh, and for a while afterwards Assyrian grip on the cities of the Levant loosened. It was in that window that Hezekiah stopped paying tribute and broke with Assyria, that the Philistine cities formed their own alliances, and that the Kushite dynasty in Egypt, operating within the framework of its Twenty-Fifth Dynasty, reached out across Sinai and poured troops and money into Palestine. The Babylonian Chronicle records Taharqa marching north into Judah and holding the gates of a besieged city together with the trapped Hezekiah, which shows that Egypt was not a bystander but the sponsor of this revolt. At a deeper level the cause was structural. The Assyrian empire worked through tribute rather than through direct occupation, and every vassal state that refused to pay the customary tribute was treated as a breach in the imperial order. After his accession Sennacherib needed a successful western campaign to reassert the empire's frontier in the Levant, to sever the link between Egypt and Kush, and to bring the Mediterranean trade route and the Lebanon timber line under effective control.
impact: 對西邊的直接後果是猶大地從此成為亞述的貢賦附庸：希西家保住王位與耶路撒冷，卻要年年繳納重稅，四十六座城邑的工事被拆毀或改造成亞述式的駐防點，被擄走的二十餘萬人（王室記錄作200,700）分批送往亞述本土與亞述控制的西部行省，許多家庭再也沒有回到故土，南方的猶大因此出現顯著的人口下降，留下來的戰俘與解體的家族成為附庸社會的底層。這次行動也把埃及與Kush的聯手徹底打斷：第二十五王朝在黎凡特的野望被逐回尼尼微河對岸，雖然塔哈卡仍保有埃及王位，卻要再等三十年，直到撒姆提克一世把Kush人逐出埃及。腓尼基各城保住城市的自主，但西頓被毀後重建，推羅維持國王的表面尊嚴，實則年年進貢；北方阿拉美與亞捫諸部重新回到亞述邊界的秩序之中。對亞述自身，這是一次用來立威的展示：首都遷到尼尼微的工程熱、寫滿戰爭自我敘述的王室銘文、以及被後人視為最生動攻城文獻的拉基什浮雕，全都與這場戰役直接相關。長期來看，這次行動也暴露了亞述的結構性弱點——主力被抽調去對付埃及與Kush，西部邊境只靠駐軍與貢賦維繫——此後西南方的每一次反叛都重演同樣的格局，直到公元前612年尼尼微陷落、帝國解體。而西征的主角辛那赫里布在公元前689年就被自己的兒子們刺殺，四年後他的繼承者才登基，帝國西部的這套貢賦秩序又撐了七十多年。
impactEn: The direct consequence in the west was that Judah became a tributary vassal of Assyria. Hezekiah kept his throne and his city, but had to pay heavy tribute year after year; the works of the forty-six cities were torn down or converted into Assyrian-style garrison points; and the more than two hundred thousand people deported, 200,700 in the royal record, were shipped in batches to Assyria proper and to the western provinces under Assyrian control. Many families never returned, southern Judah suffered a marked demographic decline, and the captives who stayed behind formed the bottom layer of the vassal society. The operation also broke the Egyptian-Kushite partnership outright: the ambitions of the Twenty-Fifth Dynasty in the Levant were pushed back to the far side of the Nile, and although Taharqa kept the Egyptian throne he had to wait another thirty years, until Psamtik I drove the Kushites out of Egypt. The Phoenician cities kept their urban autonomy, but Sidon was destroyed and rebuilt, and Tyre preserved the outward dignity of kingship while paying tribute year by year; the Aramee and Ammonite peoples of the north were folded back into the Assyrian frontier order. For Assyria itself this was a display intended to intimidate: the building boom that followed the move of the capital to Nineveh, the royal inscriptions full of a self-congratulatory narrative of war, and the Lachish reliefs, still the most vivid surviving document of siege warfare, all belong to this campaign. In the long run the operation also exposed Assyria's structural weakness: with the main army pulled away to face Egypt and Kush, the western border was held by garrisons and tribute alone, and every later revolt in the south-west followed the same pattern until Nineveh fell in 612 BC and the empire came apart. The protagonist of the western campaign himself was killed by his own sons in 689 BC, and it was another four years before his successor took the throne; the tribute system in the west held on for another seventy years after that.
result: 結果是一場沒有全勝的完勝：亞述在戰術上拿到了它想要的東西——西頓與推羅等城邦的進貢到位，希西家的四十六座城邑被逐一圍困或迫降，拉基什在攻城槌與突擊步兵之下陷落，浮雕把這一切刻成定格的畫面；前來解圍的埃及與Kush聯軍在厄爾提卡被擊潰，聯軍丟下裝備退走，猶大解圍的指望自此落空。唯一沒有解決的是耶路撒冷：亞述軍最終沒有攻破城牆，以接受希西家送來的巨額貢品與寶石作為罷兵之價；事後寄給以革倫總督的文書（記於公元前700年尼散月）提到塔哈卡的部隊已被遣散，可見戰事已經收束，亞述主力隨即轉向埃蘭。戰略上，亞述以代價換取了三樣東西：打掉了埃及的西奈立足點、把猶大變成穩定貢源、維持了腓尼基商路的通暢；代價則是主力西調期間東方與北方的空虛，以及往後埃蘭戰爭的漫長消耗——公元前689年他第二次圍困巴比倫，翌年在宮中被自己的兒子刺殺，一個把西征推到極致的君主，沒有看到帝國在公元前612年的終局。亞述與埃及在黎凡特的角力要到更晚的公元前671年才會由他的兒子再打一次，而那一回亞述贏了。
resultEn: The result was a complete success that was not a total victory. Tactically Assyria got what it came for: the tribute of Sidon, Tyre and the other client cities was paid, Hezekiah's forty-six fortified cities were besieged or compelled to surrender one by one, Lachish fell to the battering ram and the assault infantry, and the relief froze that whole sequence into a fixed image; the Egyptian and Kushite army that came to lift the siege was broken at Eltekeh, abandoning its equipment as it withdrew, and the hope of relieving Judah died with it. The one thing left unresolved was Jerusalem. The Assyrians never breached the walls; they took the enormous tribute in gold, silver and precious stones that Hezekiah sent as the price of the Assyrian withdrawal. A document later addressed to the governor of Ekron, dated to Nisan in 700 BC, reports that Taharqa's troops had been dismissed, which shows that the war was already over and that the Assyrian main force soon turned towards Elam. Strategically, Assyria bought three things at a price: the Egyptian foothold on Sinai was destroyed, Judah was turned into a reliable source of tribute, and the Phoenician trade route was kept open. The price was an empty east and north while the main army was in the west, and the long attritional cost of the later war with Elam: in 689 BC Sennacherib besieged Babylon a second time and the following year was killed by his own sons in his palace, so that the king who pushed the western campaign to its extreme never lived to see the empire's end in 612 BC. The Assyrian and Egyptian contest over the Levant was to be fought once more by his son, in 671 BC, and that time Assyria won.
